blocks.en: If you withdraw while the agents are running (up to about 25 minutes of the wait), your withdrawal counts at once and we delete your data as soon as they end.
blocks.zh: 如果你在代理运行时退出(最多25分钟的等待时间),你的退出即刻计数,一旦数据结束,我们就删除.

blocks.en: If you came from Prolific and stop before finishing without withdrawing, we don’t pay you, with two exceptions. If the eligibility check finds no usable chat, we pay you £0.50 for the check. If our server finds after you upload your chats that none can be used, we pay you £3 as a bonus.
blocks.zh: 如果你来自普罗利菲克, 如果资格检查找不到有用的聊天 我们付你0.50英镑 如果我们的服务器在您上传您的聊天信息后 发现没有人可以使用, 我们付您3英镑作为奖金。

blocks.en: For questions about your rights as a participant, contact the [institutional review board] office ([ethics office contact]). The [institutional review board] approved this study ([approval reference]).
blocks.zh: 关于您作为参与者的权利问题,请与[机构审查委员会]办公室联系([伦理办公室联系])。 [机构审查委员会]核准了本研究报告([核准参考])。

blocks.en: The main risk is that something private in your chat is uploaded to our server and passed to the model providers while the replays run. Three things reduce it: sensitive details are deleted before uploading, you choose which chats to upload after reading them, and we delete your chats once the replays are ready. What we keep (part 5) can still include text from your chat, such as your first message and what the agents read in the copy of your files. You receive the payment above, and you see how three different coding agents handle a moment from your own work.
blocks.zh: 主要的风险是,您聊天中的私密内容被上传到我们的服务器,并在重播运行时传递给模型提供者. 三件事减少了它:敏感的细节在上传前被删除,你选择读完后要上传的聊天,一旦重播准备好,我们就删除你的聊天. 我们保留的内容( 第 5 部分) 仍然可以包含您聊天时的文本, 例如您的第一个消息 以及您文件副本中的代理阅读内容 。 你收到上面的付款,你可以看到 三个不同的编码代理 处理一个时刻 从你自己的工作。

blocks.en: The frictions
blocks.zh: 摩擦

blocks.en: A friction is what stood between the person and the target over the session: a stretch of blocks where progress stalled or went backwards, work that was later undone or shown unnecessary, or a fact that was needed from the start and arrived late.
blocks.zh: 人与目标之间的摩擦是会议过程中的磨擦:进展停滞或倒退的路段,后来被取消或显示不必要的工作,或从一开始就需要而晚到的事实。

blocks.en: Which behaviours are frictions:
blocks.zh: 哪些行为是摩擦:

blocks.en: 1. A behaviour the person pushed back on is a friction , unless its why_not says what makes the push-back not a cost against the target.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 被推后的行为是一种摩擦, 除非它为什么不说是什么使得推后不是对目标的代价。

blocks.en: 2. A behaviour nobody reacted to is a friction only when what happened later shows its cost , such as the work being redone or a need arriving late.
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 只有在后来发生的事情显示出其代价时,

blocks.en: 3. Work wider than the person asked for, or work the agent did not check, is a friction only when the person reverted it, objected to it or questioned it.
blocks.zh: 3个 工作范围大于要求的人,或代理人没有检查的工作,只有在该人返回、反对或质疑时才是一种摩擦。

blocks.en: 4. A slip the agent fixed inside the same block, with no response from the person, is not a friction.
blocks.zh: 4个 在同一个区块内固定的无人反应的剂滑动不是摩擦.

blocks.en: What you write
blocks.zh: 你写的是什么

blocks.en: For every friction whose kinds is not ["none"] and whose agent_contributed is yes , two sentences describing two agents in the same situation: observed and suited . Every sentence is an instruction to a coding agent that has tools for reading, searching, editing and running commands, and it has one fixed shape.
blocks.zh: 对于其种类不是["无"]且其代理人_贡献为"是"的摩擦,两句描述在相同情况下的两种代理人:观察和适合. 每个句子都是给一个编码代理的指令,它具有读取,搜索,编辑和运行命令的工具,它有一个固定的形状.

blocks.en: The shape, in order:
blocks.zh: 形状,顺序:

blocks.en: 1. The situation, as the agent meets it. Begin with "Whenever" and describe the moment from the agent’s own seat. [… how to describe the kind of request without its words …]
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 情况,当代理满足它。 从“随时”开始, [. 如何描述没有其文字的请求类型.]

blocks.en: 2. The order. For a behaviour that adds a step: "do this before anything else, before answering and before any edit". For a behaviour that withholds a step: say plainly what is not done and until when.
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 令传. 对于一个增加一步的行为:"在回答之前,在任何编辑之前,先这样做". 对于不采取一个步骤的行为:你应当明确说出什么是不做,直到什么时候。

blocks.en: 3. The act, as a tool-visible operation. Name the operation the agent performs: search the whole repository for X, read the file that Y, run Z, ask the person W. The act must be one the run environment can perform. [… what to do when avoiding the action needs something outside the starting environment …]
blocks.zh: 3个 行为,作为工具可见的操作. 指定代理执行的操作名称: 搜索整个寄存器的 X, 读取 Y, 运行 Z, 询问个人 W. 行为必须是运行环境能够执行的 。 [... 当避免行动时, 需要在开始环境之外做点什么...]

blocks.en: 4. Where the result goes. Say where in the reply the act’s result appears.
blocks.zh: 4个 果报何处去. 请在答复中说明该行为的结果。

blocks.en: 5. The control clause , when the friction involves one: whether to act or to wait, and until what.
blocks.zh: 5.五. 控制条款,当摩擦涉及一个:是行动还是等待,直到什么。

blocks.en: Steps 2 to 5 shape the suited sentence. The observed sentence begins with the same situation (step 1) and then states only the acts the recorded agent actually took, in the order it took them. The observed and suited sentences differ only in the acts and their order, never in the situation.
blocks.zh: 第二步至第五步塑造合适的句子. 所观察的句子从同样的情况(步骤1)开始,然后只说明被记录的代理人实际采取的行为,按其收受的顺序排列. 所遵守的和适当的判决只在行为及其顺序上不同,在情况上从不不同。

blocks.en: [… rules that keep each sentence to its situation …]
blocks.zh: [. 将每一句保留到其状况的规则.]

blocks.en: A sentence is a standing behaviour, not a plan for this task. The test: the same sentence could be handed to an agent on a different task, in a different repository, unchanged, and still tell it what to do.
blocks.zh: 判决是一种站立行为,而不是这一任务的计划. 测试:同一个句子可以交给一个特工执行不同的任务,在不同的寄存器中,不变,仍然告诉它该做什么.

blocks.en: The suited sentence may be no stronger than the evidence.
blocks.zh: 合适的判决可能不会比证据更有力。

blocks.en: You grade whether the work a coding agent left behind meets each part of the result a user needed.

blocks.en: You receive the result as numbered clauses, one marked main, the difference between the repository as the session began and as it ended (new files in full), and the agent’s turns in order: what it said, and each file it edited and command it ran, with the last lines each command printed.
blocks.zh: 您收到的结果为编号条款, 一个标记主 , 当会话开始和结束时寄存器的区别( 新文件全写) , 代理器的转动顺序 : 它所说的话, 以及它编辑和命令它运行的每个文件, 并打印每个命令的最后一行 。

blocks.en: Judge the state at the end of the session. Work that was done and later undone does not count.
blocks.zh: 在开庭结束时审判国家。 已经完成但后来被撤销的工作不算数。

blocks.en: Mark every clause on its own, in order, with these rules:
blocks.zh: 按照这些规则,将每一条款单独标出:

blocks.en: 1. A clause about the code is judged from the repository difference. It is met when the final code does what the clause asks, however it was implemented. The agent’s description of its code never stands in for the code.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 关于代码的条款是从寄存器的区别判断出来的. 如果最终守则按条款的要求行事,就满足了要求,但条款得到了执行。 代理商对其代码的描述从来不代表代码.

blocks.en: 2. A clause about a check (tests, lint, formatting, a build, a command working) is met when the last run of that check printed a passing result. […]
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 关于检查的条款(测试、 提示、 格式化、 构建、 命令工作) 当检查的最后一个运行打印一个通过的结果时, 将满足 。 [...]

blocks.en: 3. A clause about something the repository cannot show (a push, a pull request, a copy to the clipboard, a program run elsewhere) is met when a command’s printed output shows it, or when the agent reports having done it and nothing it printed or said later contradicts the report.
blocks.zh: 3个 当一个命令的打印输出显示时, 或当代理报到已完成, 且它没有打印或后来说出与报告相矛盾时, 符合关于寄存器无法显示的内容的条款( 推、 拉请求、 复制到剪贴板、 程序运行到其他地方) 。

blocks.en: 4. A clause about telling the user something is met when the agent’s messages, taken together by the end, give the user every point the clause names.
blocks.zh: 4个 一个告诉用户某事的条款,当代理信件在结尾时一并给用户每一点条款名称时,就满足了.

blocks.en: 5. A clause with several parts, or about all or every case, is met only when every part and every case holds.
blocks.zh: 5.五. 只有在每一部分和每一案件都存在的情况下,才符合包含若干部分或所有或每个案件的条款。

blocks.en: 6. A clause applies unless it only makes sense on a way of doing the work that this run did not take. […]
blocks.zh: 6个 一项条款适用,除非它只在进行这项审查没有进行的工作时才有意义。 [...]

blocks.en: 7. When the evidence neither shows a clause holds nor shows it fails, it is not met. Say what is missing.
blocks.zh: 7个 如果证据没有表明条款存在,也没有表明条款失败,则不符合条款。 说少了什么

blocks.en: For each clause give its index, then one or two sentences of evidence naming what shows it or what is missing, then the block IDs it rests on, then outside_the_run, applies and met. Do not judge the user’s messages, the agent’s tone, or how many turns it took.

blocks.en: Pushing back is a reaction against the agent’s work or claims. Choose one kind:
blocks.zh: 推回是针对代理人的工作或主张的反应。 选择一种 :

blocks.en: • corrected: the person says the agent got something wrong, misunderstood, or did it differently from what was asked, and wants it fixed.
blocks.zh: ^ 更正:当事人称代理人有错误,误解,或与所问不同,要求固定.

blocks.en: • rejected: the person refuses, reverts or declines what the agent did or proposed, including a tool call the person refused to allow.
blocks.zh: • 拒绝:该人拒绝、退回或拒绝代理人所作或提议的内容,包括拒绝允许使用的工具。

blocks.en: • interrupted: the person stopped the agent before it finished its turn.
blocks.zh: • 中断:该人在代理商结束交易之前就阻止了代理商。

blocks.en: • redirected: because of what the agent did, the person changes the approach or what the agent should work on.
blocks.zh: · 重新定向:由于代理人的行为,该人改变了做法或代理人应如何开展工作。

blocks.en: • none: the person does not push back. They accept the work and move on, give the next step after the agent finished what was asked, answer the agent’s question, add information the agent could not have had, or ask for information or an explanation.
blocks.zh: • 无:该人不退缩。 他们接受这项工作,然后继续工作,在代理人完成询问后采取下一步行动,回答代理人的问题,增加代理人不可能得到的信息,或者要求提供信息或解释。
